description: Owner hardware test of the FL Esports MK870 from OpenKey (experimental writes), reported in OpenKey issue #13
device: FL Esports MK870, wired (USB 0416:C345 'Gaming Keyboard', Nuvoton/Winbond M252)
interface: FF1B:0091, output and input report 1 (63 B)
method: The keyboard's owner applied each feature from OpenKey and confirmed the result on the keyboard itself (lights, typed keys, macro playback). The keyboard cannot report these settings, so there is no read-back.

verified.result: all lighting effects work as expected

notTested.reason: the tested app version kept Review and send disabled on the Fn layer; FN1 writes are enabled since

observations: When the app connected, the lighting looked off or black (RGB 0,0,0) and Fn+Up brightness had no visible effect until another effect was chosen. That app version sent the official driver's lighting query (07 01) and model query (15) on connection; OpenKey no longer sends anything on connection.

Built-in Fn shortcuts from the manual (lighting, Fn+Esc factory reset, Fn+Tab FN1 layer, Fn+Win lock, media Fn+F2 to F8, Fn+F12 key lock, speed and brightness) all work; Fn+F1, F9, F10 and F11 (player, email, home page, calculator) did not launch anything on COSMIC; Fn+~ (rollover mode) inconclusive.
